title: Among female patients diagnosed with either MCTD or SLE who had laboratory
question: Among female patients diagnosed with either MCTD or SLE who had laboratory tests between 1983 and 1985 and were under 55 years old at the time of testing, identify those with a platelet count in the normal range (100–400) and a negative KCT coagulation result. For these patients, return their ID, age at test time, and the date of the laboratory test, ordered by age descending.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P."XCL_058",
    L."XCL_016",
    L."XCL_015"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
JOIN Examination AS E ON P."XCL_058" = E."XCL_001"
WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
  AND P."XCL_064" IN ('MCTD', 'SLE')
  AND L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1985-12-31'
  AND L."XCL_016" < 55
  AND L."XCL_027" BETWEEN 100 AND 400
  AND E."XCL_009" = '-'
ORDER BY L."XCL_016" DESC
